comment: External root of trust for the SKILL PACKAGE distribution (distinct from knowledge/trust-anchor.json, which anchors knowledge bundles). It pins the Sigstore build-provenance identity an official AttestArc skill-release tarball must carry, and lives OUTSIDE the tarball it verifies (a bundle can never declare its own trust). install.py --from-tarball runs `gh attestation verify` against this identity BEFORE extracting/installing. A plain `git clone --branch <tag>` does NOT verify the tag's SSH signature; the attested-tarball path is the cryptographic install-time check. Root-of-trust: two-party review (THREAT_MODEL.md §6).
